title: Voucher used
description: A voucher was used. Loyalty consumes a voucher at most once; `useRef` is the caller's idempotency reference for the use and `usedAt` is when it happened. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

voucherId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the voucher.

code.description: The single-use voucher code that was used.

rewardId.description: The reward the voucher was issued for.

redemptionId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the reward redemption that issued the voucher.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member.

expiresAt.description: When the voucher stops being usable, in UTC.

useRef.description: The caller's idempotency reference for the use, so the same use replays instead of consuming the voucher twice.

usedAt.description: When the voucher was used, in UTC.
